_doc: Narration for {{TITLE}}. 'cap' = Roman Hinglish caption, 'tts' = what Liam reads (Hindi in Devanagari, English words in English); phrase punctuation must match. Each line opens 'scene'; 'cut' {phrase, scene} starts another scene at a phrase; 'min' = minimum scene length, 'pre' = designed silence before the line. Every claim from docs/factcheck.md. bpm = the score tempo (a song's MEASURED bpm from audio/beats.json if the reel uses a song).
